title.zh: 卷三十二 志第八 曆二
title.raw: 卷三十二 志第八 曆二 Volume 32 Treatises 8: Calendar 2

sentences.zh: 志第八 曆二

translations.literal: Treatise 8, Calendar 2.
translations.idiomatic: Treatise Eight: Calendrics, Part Two.

sentences.zh: ▲大統曆法一上法原

translations.literal: ▲ Grand Concordance Calendar Method One Upper: Origins of the Method.
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Grand Concordance Calendar Method, Part One (Upper): Origins of the Method.

sentences.zh: 造曆者各有本原，史宜備錄，使後世有以考。

translations.literal: Calendar-makers each have their own origins; the history ought fully record them so later ages may have means to examine.
translations.idiomatic: Every calendar rests on its own foundations, and the dynastic history ought record them in full so later generations can investigate.

sentences.zh: 如《太初》之起數鐘律，《大衍》之造端蓍策，皆詳本志。

translations.literal: As the Taichu's starting numbers from pitch-pipes, the Dayan's originating from yarrow stalks—all are detailed in their respective treatises.
translations.idiomatic: The Taichu calendar's grounding in pitch-pipes and musical regulation and the Dayan's in yarrow-casting are both set forth at length in their respective treatises.

sentences.zh: 《授時曆》以測算術爲宗，惟求合天，不牽合律呂、卦爻。

translations.literal: The Season Granting Calendar takes measurement-and-computation as its master, only seeking agreement with heaven, not yoked to pitch-pipes or hexagram lines.
translations.idiomatic: The Season Granting Calendar takes observational computation as its foundation, seeking only agreement with the heavens and not forcing alignment with pitch-pipes or hexagram lines.

sentences.zh: 然其法所以立，數之所從出，以及晷影、星度，皆有全書。

translations.literal: Yet how its methods stand, whence its numbers come, and gnomon shadows and star degrees—all have complete books.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the rationale of its methods, the derivation of its constants, and the full treatment of gnomon shadows and stellar degrees all survive in complete texts.

sentences.zh: 郭守敬、齊履謙傳中，有書名可考。

translations.literal: In the biographies of Guo Shoujing and Qi Lüqian, book titles may be examined.
translations.idiomatic: Titles of those works can still be traced in the biographies of Guo Shoujing and Qi Lüqian.

sentences.zh: 《元史》漫無採摭，僅存李謙之《議祿》、《曆經》之初稿。

translations.literal: The Yuan History excerpts almost nothing at random; only the draft of Li Qian's Discourse on Emoluments and Calendar Classic survives.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan History excerpts almost nothing; only Li Qian's draft Discourse on Official Emoluments and Calendar Classic remains.

sentences.zh: 其後改三應率及立成之數，與夫割圓弧矢之法，平立定三差之原，盡削不載。

translations.literal: Later changes to the three response rates and ready-table numbers, the arc-sagitta circle-division methods, and the origins of the mean, upright, and fixed three differences—all were cut away and not recorded.
translations.idiomatic: Later revisions to the three response rates and tabular constants, the arc-sagitta circle-division methods, and the foundations of the mean, upright, and fixed three differences were all excised and omitted.

sentences.zh: 使作者精意湮沒，識者憾焉。

translations.literal: The authors' fine intent was thereby submerged; knowing persons regret it.
translations.idiomatic: The compilers' careful thought was thereby lost—a source of regret for those who understand the matter.

sentences.zh: 今據《大統因通軌》及《歷草》諸書，稍爲編次，首法原，次立成，次推步。

translations.literal: Now according to the Grand Concordance Comprehensive Track, Draft Calendar, and other books, slightly arranged in order: first origins of method, next ready tables, next stepwise computation.
translations.idiomatic: The present account draws on the Grand Concordance Comprehensive Track, the Draft Calendar, and related works, arranged as follows: first the method's origins, then the tabular constants, then stepwise computation.

sentences.zh: 而法原之目七：曰句股測望，曰弧矢割圓，曰黃赤道內外度，曰白道交周，曰日月五星平立定三差，曰裏差刻漏。

translations.literal: The headings of origins of method are seven: called gnomonic surveying; called arc-sagitta circle division; called ecliptic and equator inner and outer degrees; called white-path crossing circuit; called sun, moon, and five planets mean, upright, and fixed three differences; called terrestrial parallax and clepsydra.
translations.idiomatic: The origins of the method comprise seven topics: gnomonic surveying; arc-sagitta circle division; ecliptic and equatorial inner and outer degrees; the white path's crossing circuit; the mean, upright, and fixed three differences for the sun, moon, and five planets; and terrestrial parallax with clepsydra graduations.

sentences.zh: ▲句股測望

translations.literal: ▲ Gnomonic surveying.
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Gnomonic Surveying.

sentences.zh: 北京立四丈表，冬至日午正，測得景辰七丈九尺八寸五分。

translations.literal: At Beijing a four-zhang gnomon was erected; at noon proper on the winter solstice the measured shadow reading was seven zhang, nine chi, eight cun, and five fen.
translations.idiomatic: At Beijing a four-zhang gnomon was set up; at true noon on the winter solstice its shadow measured seven zhang, nine chi, eight cun, and five fen.

sentences.zh: 隨以簡儀測到太陽南至地平二十六度四十六分半，爲半弧背。

translations.literal: Then with the simplified armillary the Sun south of the equator was measured to the horizon at twenty-six degrees forty-six minutes and a half, as the half-arc back.
translations.idiomatic: The simplified armillary then gave the Sun's south declination above the horizon as 26°46′30″, taken as the half-arc back.

sentences.zh: 求得矢度，五度九十一分半。

translations.literal: The sagitta was obtained: five degrees ninety-one minutes and a half.
translations.idiomatic: The sagitta came to 5°91′30″.

sentences.zh: 置周天半徑，截矢餘五十四度九十六分爲股，乃本地支戴日下之度。

translations.literal: Set the half-radius of the circuit of heaven; cut the sagitta remainder fifty-four degrees ninety-six minutes as the leg—this is the local degree of the branch bearing the subsolar point.
translations.idiomatic: Take the celestial half-diameter and subtract the sagitta; the remainder, 54°96′, is the leg—the local colatitude under the subsolar point.

sentences.zh: 以弦股別句術，求得句二十六度一下七分六十六秒，爲日出地半弧弦。

translations.literal: By the chord-and-leg method for separating the leg, the leg was obtained as twenty-six degrees, one fen down, seven fen sixty-six seconds, as the half-arc chord of the Sun's emergence from earth.
translations.idiomatic: Applying the chord–leg separation to obtain the other leg yielded 26°07′66″ as the half-arc chord of the Sun's altitude above the horizon.

sentences.zh: 北京立四丈表，夏至日午正，測得景長一丈一尺七寸一分。

translations.literal: At Beijing a four-zhang gnomon was erected; at noon proper on the summer solstice the measured shadow length was one zhang, one chi, seven cun, and one fen.
translations.idiomatic: At Beijing a four-zhang gnomon was set up; at true noon on the summer solstice its shadow measured one zhang, one chi, seven cun, and one fen.

sentences.zh: 隨以簡儀測到太陽南至地平七十四度二十六分半，爲半弧背。

translations.literal: Then with the simplified armillary the Sun south of the equator was measured to the horizon at seventy-four degrees twenty-six minutes and a half, as the half-arc back.
translations.idiomatic: The simplified armillary then gave the Sun's south declination above the horizon as 74°26′30″, taken as the half-arc back.

sentences.zh: 求得矢度，四十三度七十四分少。

translations.literal: The sagitta was obtained: forty-three degrees seventy-four minutes, slightly less.
translations.idiomatic: The sagitta came to 43°74′, slightly less.

sentences.zh: 置周天半徑，截矢餘一十七度一十三分二十五秒爲句，乃本地去戴日下之度。

translations.literal: Set the half-radius of the circuit of heaven; cut the sagitta remainder seventeen degrees thirteen minutes twenty-five seconds as the leg—this is the local degree away from the subsolar point.
translations.idiomatic: Take the celestial half-diameter and subtract the sagitta; the remainder, 17°13′25″, is the leg—the local distance from the subsolar point.

sentences.zh: 以句弦別股術，求得股五十八度四十五分半，爲日出地半弧弦。

translations.literal: By the leg-and-chord method for separating the base leg, the base leg was obtained as fifty-eight degrees forty-five minutes and a half, as the half-arc chord of the Sun's emergence from earth.
translations.idiomatic: Applying the leg–chord separation to obtain the base leg yielded 58°45′30″ as the half-arc chord of the Sun's altitude above the horizon.

sentences.zh: 以二至日度相併，得一百度七十三分，折半得五十度三十六分半，爲北京赤道出地度。

translations.literal: Combine the solstice day-degrees, obtaining one hundred degrees seventy-three minutes; halve to obtain fifty degrees thirty-six minutes and a half, as Beijing's equator-above-horizon degree.
translations.idiomatic: Adding the two solstice altitudes gives 100°73′; halving yields 50°36′30″ as Beijing's equatorial altitude above the horizon.

sentences.zh: 以赤道出地度轉減周天四之一，餘四十度九十四分九十三秒七十五微，爲北京北極出地度。

translations.literal: Subtract the equator-above-horizon degree from one quarter of the circuit of heaven; the remainder forty degrees ninety-four minutes ninety-three seconds seventy-five micro-units is Beijing's north pole above earth.
translations.idiomatic: Subtracting the equatorial altitude from a quadrant of the celestial circuit leaves 40°94′93″75 as Beijing's polar altitude above the horizon.

sentences.zh: ▲弧矢割圓

translations.literal: ▲ Arc-sagitta circle division.
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Arc-Sagitta Circle Division.

sentences.zh: 周天經一百二十一度七十五分少。

translations.literal: The circuit of heaven's diameter is one hundred twenty-one degrees seventy-five minutes, slightly less.
translations.idiomatic: The celestial diameter is fixed at 121°75′, slightly less.

sentences.zh: 少不用。

translations.literal: The 'slightly less' is not used.
translations.idiomatic: The 'slightly less' fraction is dropped in use.

sentences.zh: 半徑六十零度八十七分半。

translations.literal: Half-radius sixty degrees eighty-seven minutes and a half.
translations.idiomatic: The half-diameter is 60°87′30″.

sentences.zh: 又爲黃赤道大弦。

translations.literal: This also serves as the great chord of the yellow and red paths.
translations.idiomatic: This value also serves as the great chord linking ecliptic and equator.

sentences.zh: 二至黃赤道內外半弧背二十四度。

translations.literal: At the two solstices the inner and outer half-arc backs of the yellow and red paths are twenty-four degrees.
translations.idiomatic: At the solstices the inner and outer half-arc backs on the ecliptic and equator are 24°.

sentences.zh: 所測就整。

translations.literal: What was measured is taken as whole numbers.
translations.idiomatic: Observed values are used as rounded integers.

sentences.zh: 二至黃赤道弧矢四度八十四分十二秒。

translations.literal: At the two solstices the yellow-and-red arc sagitta is four degrees eighty-four minutes twelve seconds.
translations.idiomatic: At the solstices the ecliptic–equatorial arc sagitta is 4°84′12″.

sentences.zh: 黃赤道大句二十三度八十分七十秒。

translations.literal: Great leg of yellow and red paths twenty-three degrees eighty minutes seventy seconds.
translations.idiomatic: The great altitude leg of the ecliptic–equatorial triangle is 23°80′70″.

sentences.zh: 黃赤道大股五十六度零二分六十八秒。

translations.literal: Great base leg of yellow and red paths fifty-six degrees two minutes sixty-eight seconds.
translations.idiomatic: The great base leg of the ecliptic–equatorial triangle is 56°02′68″.

sentences.zh: 半徑內減去矢度之數。

translations.literal: The number obtained by subtracting the sagitta from within the half-radius.
translations.idiomatic: This is the half-diameter minus the sagitta.

sentences.zh: 割圓求矢術 置半弧度自之，爲半弧背幕，周天徑自之，爲上廉。

translations.literal: Arc-sagitta circle-division method for seeking sagitta: set the half-arc back and square it as the half-arc-back power; square the circuit-of-heaven diameter as the upper excess.
translations.idiomatic: Method for finding the sagitta by circle division: square the half-arc back to obtain the half-arc-back power; square the celestial diameter to obtain the upper excess.

sentences.zh: 上廉乘半弧背幕，爲正實。

translations.literal: Multiply the upper excess by the half-arc-back power as the positive product.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the upper excess by the half-arc-back power to form the positive product.

sentences.zh: 上廉乘徑，爲益從方。

translations.literal: Multiply the upper excess by the diameter as the augmenting companion square.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the upper excess by the diameter to form the augmenting companion square.

sentences.zh: 半弧背倍之，乘徑，爲下廉。

translations.literal: Double the half-arc back and multiply by the diameter as the lower excess.
translations.idiomatic: Double the half-arc back and multiply by the diameter to form the lower excess.

sentences.zh: 以初商乘上廉，得數以減益從方，餘爲從方。

translations.literal: Multiply the initial quotient by the upper excess; subtract the number from the augmenting companion square; the remainder is the companion square.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the first trial quotient by the upper excess, subtract from the augmenting companion square, and take the remainder as the companion square.

sentences.zh: 置初商自之以下廉，餘以初商乘之，爲從廉。

translations.literal: Square the initial quotient and subtract from the lower excess; multiply the remainder by the initial quotient as the companion excess.
translations.idiomatic: Square the first trial quotient, subtract from the lower excess, and multiply the remainder by the first trial quotient to obtain the companion excess.

sentences.zh: 從方、從廉相併，爲下法。

translations.literal: Combine the companion square and companion excess as the lower divisor.
translations.idiomatic: Add the companion square and companion excess to form the lower divisor.

sentences.zh: 下法乘初商，以減正實，實不足減，改初商。

translations.literal: Multiply the lower divisor by the initial quotient and subtract from the positive product; if the product is insufficient, revise the initial quotient.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the lower divisor by the first trial quotient and subtract from the positive product; if the product is insufficient, adjust the first quotient.

sentences.zh: 實有不盡，次第商除之。

translations.literal: If the product is not exhausted, continue quotient-division in sequence.
translations.idiomatic: If a remainder remains, continue successive quotient divisions.

sentences.zh: 倍初商數，與次商相併以乘上廉，得數以減益從方，餘爲從方。

translations.literal: Double the initial quotient, combine with the second quotient, multiply by the upper excess; subtract the number from the augmenting companion square; the remainder is the companion square.
translations.idiomatic: Double the first quotient, add the second quotient, multiply by the upper excess, subtract from the augmenting companion square, and take the remainder as the companion square.

sentences.zh: 並初商次商而自之，又以初商自之，並二數以減下廉，餘以初商倍數並次商乘之，爲從廉。

translations.literal: Square the initial and second quotients together, also square the initial quotient; combine the two numbers and subtract from the lower excess; multiply the remainder by the doubled initial quotient together with the second quotient as the companion excess.
translations.idiomatic: Square the sum of the first and second quotients and also square the first quotient alone; subtract both from the lower excess; multiply the remainder by twice the first quotient plus the second quotient to obtain the companion excess.

sentences.zh: 從方、從廉相併，爲下法。

translations.literal: Combine the companion square and companion excess as the lower divisor.
translations.idiomatic: Add the companion square and companion excess to form the lower divisor.

sentences.zh: 下法乘次商，以減餘實，而定次商。

translations.literal: Multiply the lower divisor by the second quotient and subtract from the remaining product, thereby fixing the second quotient.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the lower divisor by the second quotient, subtract from the remaining product, and thereby fix the second quotient.

sentences.zh: 有不盡者，如法商之，皆以商得數爲矢度之數。

translations.literal: If not exhausted, divide by the method; in each case the quotient obtained is the number of sagitta degrees.
translations.idiomatic: If a remainder still remains, continue dividing by the same procedure; each quotient obtained contributes to the sagitta in degrees.

sentences.zh: 黃赤道同用。

translations.literal: Yellow and red paths use it alike.
translations.idiomatic: The ecliptic and equator employ the same procedure.

sentences.zh: 如以半弧背一度求矢。

translations.literal: For example, to seek the sagitta from a half-arc back of one degree.
translations.idiomatic: Example: to find the sagitta for a half-arc back of one degree.

sentences.zh: 術曰：置半弧背一度自之，得一度，爲半弧幕。

translations.literal: Method says: set the half-arc back of one degree and square it, obtaining one degree as the half-arc power.
translations.idiomatic: The procedure runs: square a half-arc back of one degree to obtain 1° as the half-arc power.

sentences.zh: 置周天徑一百二十一度太自之，得一萬四千八百二十三度零六分二十五秒，爲上廉。

translations.literal: Set the circuit-of-heaven diameter one hundred twenty-one degrees slightly more and square it, obtaining fourteen thousand eight hundred twenty-three degrees six minutes twenty-five seconds as the upper excess.
translations.idiomatic: Square the celestial diameter 121° slightly more to obtain 14,823°06′25″ as the upper excess.

sentences.zh: 上廉乘半弧背幕，得一萬四千八百二十三度零六分二五，爲正實。

translations.literal: Multiply the upper excess by the half-arc-back power, obtaining fourteen thousand eight hundred twenty-three degrees six minutes twenty-five as the positive product.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the upper excess by the half-arc power to obtain 14,823°06′25″ as the positive product.

sentences.zh: 上廉又乘徑，得一百八十零萬四千七百零七度八十五分九十三秒七五，爲益從方。

translations.literal: The upper excess again multiplies the diameter, obtaining one million eight hundred four thousand seven hundred seven degrees eighty-five minutes ninety-three seconds seventy-five as the augmenting companion square.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the upper excess again by the diameter to obtain 1,804,707°85′93″75 as the augmenting companion square.

sentences.zh: 半弧背一度倍之，得二度，以乘徑得二百四十三度五十分，爲下廉。

translations.literal: Double the half-arc back of one degree to obtain two degrees; multiply by the diameter to obtain two hundred forty-three degrees fifty minutes as the lower excess.
translations.idiomatic: Double the one-degree half-arc back to obtain 2°; multiply by the diameter to obtain 243°50′ as the lower excess.

sentences.zh: 初商八十秒。

translations.literal: Initial quotient eighty seconds.
translations.idiomatic: First trial quotient: 80″.

sentences.zh: 置初商八十秒乘上廉一萬四千八百二十三度零六二五，得一百一十八度五八四五，以減益從方一百八十零萬四千七百零七度八五九三七五，餘一百八十零萬四千五百八十九度二七四八七五，爲從方。

translations.literal: Set initial quotient eighty seconds multiplying upper excess fourteen thousand eight hundred twenty-three degrees six minutes twenty-five, obtaining one hundred eighteen degrees fifty-eight forty-five; subtract from augmenting companion square one million eight hundred four thousand seven hundred seven degrees eighty-five minutes ninety-three seconds seventy-five; remainder one million eight hundred four thousand five hundred eighty-nine degrees twenty-seven minutes forty-eight seconds seventy-five as companion square.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the first quotient 80″ by the upper excess 14,823°0625 to obtain 118°5845; subtract from the augmenting companion square 1,804,707°859375; the remainder 1,804,589°274875 is the companion square.

sentences.zh: 又置初商八十秒自之，得六十四微，以減下廉餘二百四十三度四九九三六。

translations.literal: Again set initial quotient eighty seconds squared, obtaining sixty-four micro-units; subtract from lower excess remainder two hundred forty-three degrees forty-nine ninety-three six.
translations.idiomatic: Square the first quotient 80″ to obtain 64 micro-units; subtract from the lower-excess remainder 243°49936.

sentences.zh: 仍以八十秒乘之，得一度九四七九九九四八八，爲從廉。

translations.literal: Still multiply by eighty seconds, obtaining one degree ninety-four seventy-nine nine nine four eight eight as companion excess.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply again by 80″ to obtain 1°947999488 as the companion excess.

sentences.zh: 以從廉、從方並之，共得一百八十零萬四千五百九十一度二二二八七四四八八，爲下法。

translations.literal: Combine companion excess and companion square, together obtaining one million eight hundred four thousand five hundred ninety-one degrees twenty-two minutes twenty-eight seconds seventy-four four eight eight as lower divisor.
translations.idiomatic: Add companion excess and companion square to obtain 1,804,591°222874488 as the lower divisor.

sentences.zh: 下法乘初商，得一萬四千四百三十六度七十二分九七八二九九五九零四，以減正實，餘實三百八十六度三十三分二七一七零零四零九六。

translations.literal: Multiply lower divisor by initial quotient, obtaining fourteen thousand four hundred thirty-six degrees seventy-two minutes ninety-seven eighty-two ninety-five nine zero four; subtract from positive product; remaining product three hundred eighty-six degrees thirty-three minutes twenty-seven seventeen zero zero four zero nine six.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the lower divisor by the first quotient to obtain 14,436°729782995904; subtract from the positive product; the remainder is 386°332717004096.

sentences.zh: 次商二秒。

translations.literal: Second quotient two seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Second trial quotient: 2″.

sentences.zh: 置初商八十秒倍之，得一分六十秒。

translations.literal: Set initial quotient eighty seconds doubled, obtaining one minute sixty seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Double the first quotient 80″ to obtain 1′60″.

sentences.zh: 加次商二委六十二秒，乘上廉一萬四千八百二十三度零六二五，得二百四十零度一三三六一二五，以減益從方，餘一百八十零萬四千四百六十七二五七六二五，爲從方。

translations.literal: Add second quotient two yielding sixty-two seconds; multiply upper excess fourteen thousand eight hundred twenty-three degrees six minutes twenty-five, obtaining two hundred forty degrees thirteen minutes thirty-six twelve five; subtract from augmenting companion square; remainder one million eight hundred four thousand four hundred sixty-seven degrees twenty-five seventy-six twenty-five as companion square.
translations.idiomatic: Add the second quotient 2″ to obtain 82″; multiply by the upper excess 14,823°0625 to obtain 240°1336125; subtract from the augmenting companion square; the remainder 1,804,467°257625 is the companion square.

sentences.zh: 又置初次商八十二秒自之，得六十七微。

translations.literal: Again set initial and second quotients eighty-two seconds squared, obtaining sixty-seven micro-units.
translations.idiomatic: Square the combined first and second quotient 82″ to obtain 67 micro-units.

sentences.zh: 加初商八十秒自之之數，得一秒三十一微，以減下廉，餘二百四十三度四九九八六九。

translations.literal: Add the number from squaring initial quotient eighty seconds, obtaining one second thirty-one micro-units; subtract from lower excess; remainder two hundred forty-three degrees forty-nine ninety-eight six nine.
translations.idiomatic: Add the square of the first quotient alone (80″) to obtain 1″31μ; subtract from the lower excess; the remainder is 243°499869.

sentences.zh: 以前所得一分六十二秒乘之，得三度九十四分四六九七八七七八，爲從廉。

translations.literal: Multiply by the previously obtained one minute sixty-two seconds, obtaining three degrees ninety-four minutes forty-six nine seven eight seven seven eight as companion excess.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by the 1′62″ obtained above to get 3°9446978778 as the companion excess.

sentences.zh: 以從廉、從方並，得一百八十零萬四千四百七十一度六十七分零四六零三七八，爲下法。

translations.literal: Combine companion excess and companion square, obtaining one million eight hundred four thousand four hundred seventy-one degrees sixty-seven minutes four six zero three seven eight as lower divisor.
translations.idiomatic: Add companion excess and companion square to obtain 1,804,471°670460378 as the lower divisor.

sentences.zh: 下法乘次商，得三百六十零度八九四三三四零九二零七五五六，以減餘實，仍餘二十五度四三八三八二九一二零二零四四。

translations.literal: Multiply lower divisor by second quotient, obtaining three hundred sixty degrees eighty-nine forty-three three four zero nine two zero seven five five six; subtract from remaining product; still remainder twenty-five degrees four three eight three eight two nine one two zero two zero four four.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the lower divisor by the second quotient to obtain 360°89433409207556; subtract from the remaining product; the remainder is 25°43838291202044.

sentences.zh: 不足一秒葉不用，下同。

translations.literal: When less than one second, leaf-discard is not used; same below.
translations.idiomatic: Fractions below one second are discarded; the same rule applies below.

sentences.zh: 凡求得矢度八十二秒，餘度各如上法，求到矢度，以爲黃赤相求及其內外度之根。

translations.literal: In all the sagitta obtained is eighty seconds; for the remaining degrees each follows the above method, seeking down to the sagitta, to serve as the root of yellow-and-red mutual seeking and their inner and outer degrees.
translations.idiomatic: In all, the sagitta obtained is 82″; for other arc lengths apply the same procedure to obtain the sagitta—the foundation for converting between ecliptic and equator and for their inner and outer degrees.

sentences.zh: 數詳後。

translations.literal: Numbers detailed later.
translations.idiomatic: The full tables appear below.

sentences.zh: ▲黃赤道差

translations.literal: ▲ Yellow-and-red difference.
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Ecliptic–Equatorial Difference.

sentences.zh: 求黃赤道各度下赤道積度術。

translations.literal: Method for seeking under each ecliptic degree the accumulated equatorial degree.
translations.idiomatic: Method for finding the accumulated equatorial degree corresponding to each ecliptic degree.

sentences.zh: 置周天半徑內減去黃道矢度，餘爲黃赤道小弦。

translations.literal: Set the half-radius of the circuit of heaven and subtract the ecliptic sagitta; the remainder is the small chord of yellow and red paths.
translations.idiomatic: Take the celestial half-diameter and subtract the ecliptic sagitta; the remainder is the small ecliptic–equatorial chord.

sentences.zh: 置黃赤道小弦，以黃赤道大股乘之大股見割圓爲實。

translations.literal: Set the small chord of yellow and red paths; multiply by the great base leg of yellow and red paths—the great base leg appears in circle division—as product.
translations.idiomatic: Set the small chord and multiply by the great base leg of the ecliptic–equatorial triangle (given under circle division) to form the product.

sentences.zh: 黃赤道大弦半徑爲法。

translations.literal: The great chord of yellow and red paths, the half-radius, serves as divisor.
translations.idiomatic: Use the great chord—that is, the half-diameter—as divisor.

sentences.zh: 實如法而一，爲黃赤道小股。

translations.literal: Product according to divisor yields one, as the small base leg of yellow and red paths.
translations.idiomatic: Divide the product by the divisor to obtain the small base leg of the ecliptic–equatorial triangle.

sentences.zh: 直黃道矢自乘爲實，以周天全徑爲法，實如法而一，爲黃道半背弦差。

translations.literal: Square the ecliptic sagitta directly as product; take the full diameter of the circuit of heaven as divisor; product according to divisor yields one, as the ecliptic half-back chord difference.
translations.idiomatic: Square the ecliptic sagitta for the product, divide by the full celestial diameter, and obtain the ecliptic half-back chord correction.

sentences.zh: 以差去減黃赤道積度，即黃道半弧背。

translations.literal: Subtract the difference from the accumulated yellow-and-red degree; that is the ecliptic half-arc back.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract this correction from the accumulated ecliptic degree to obtain the ecliptic half-arc back.

sentences.zh: 餘爲黃道半弧弦。

translations.literal: The remainder is the ecliptic half-arc chord.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder is the ecliptic half-arc chord.

sentences.zh: 置黃赤道半弧弦自之爲股幕，黃赤道小股自之爲句幕，二幕並之，以開平方法除之，爲赤道小弦。

translations.literal: Set the yellow-and-red half-arc chord squared as leg power; set the small base leg of yellow and red paths squared as altitude power; combine the two powers and extract by square-root method as the small equatorial chord.
translations.idiomatic: Square the ecliptic half-arc chord for the leg power and the small base leg for the altitude power; add the two powers and take the square root to obtain the small equatorial chord.

sentences.zh: 置黃赤道半弧弦，以周天半徑亦爲赤道大弦乘之爲實，以赤道小弦爲法而一，爲赤道半弧弦。

translations.literal: Set the yellow-and-red half-arc chord; also take the half-radius of the circuit of heaven as the great equatorial chord and multiply as product; divide by the small equatorial chord to obtain one, as the equatorial half-arc chord.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the ecliptic half-arc chord by the half-diameter (the great equatorial chord) for the product and divide by the small equatorial chord to obtain the equatorial half-arc chord.

sentences.zh: 置黃赤道小股，亦爲赤道橫小句以赤道大弦即半徑乘之爲實，以赤道小弦爲法而一，爲赤道橫大句，以減半徑，餘爲赤道磺弧矢。

translations.literal: Set the small base leg of yellow and red paths; also as the equatorial transverse small altitude multiply by the great equatorial chord—that is, the half-radius—as product; divide by the small equatorial chord to obtain one, as the equatorial transverse great altitude; subtract from half-radius; the remainder is the equatorial transverse arc sagitta.
translations.idiomatic: Take the small base leg as the equatorial transverse small altitude, multiply by the half-diameter for the product, divide by the small equatorial chord to obtain the transverse great altitude; subtract from the half-diameter; the remainder is the equatorial transverse arc sagitta.

sentences.zh: 橫弧矢自之爲實，以全徑爲法而一，爲赤道半背弦差。

translations.literal: Square the transverse arc sagitta as product; take the full diameter as divisor; product according to divisor yields one, as the equatorial half-back chord difference.
translations.idiomatic: Square the transverse arc sagitta, divide by the full diameter, and obtain the equatorial half-back chord correction.

sentences.zh: 以差加赤道半弧，爲赤道積度。

translations.literal: Add the difference to the equatorial half-arc; that is the accumulated equatorial degree.
translations.idiomatic: Add this correction to the equatorial half-arc to obtain the accumulated equatorial degree.

sentences.zh: 如黃道半弧背一度，求赤道積度。

translations.literal: For example, ecliptic half-arc back one degree, seek accumulated equatorial degree.
translations.idiomatic: Example: for an ecliptic half-arc back of one degree, find the accumulated equatorial degree.

sentences.zh: 術曰：「置半徑六十零度八十七分五十秒，即黃赤道大弦。

translations.literal: Method says: "Set half-radius sixty degrees eighty-seven minutes fifty seconds—that is, the great chord of yellow and red paths.
translations.idiomatic: The procedure runs: "Set the half-diameter at 60°87′50″—this is the great ecliptic–equatorial chord.

sentences.zh: 內減黃道矢八十二秒餘六十零度八六六八，爲黃赤道小弦。

translations.literal: Within subtract ecliptic sagitta eighty seconds; remainder sixty degrees eighty-six minutes sixty-eight as small chord of yellow and red paths.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the ecliptic sagitta 82″; the remainder 60°8668 is the small ecliptic–equatorial chord.

sentences.zh: 置黃赤道小弦，以黃赤道大股五十六度零二六八乘之，得三千四百一十零度一七二零三零二四爲實，以黃赤道大弦六十零度八七五爲法，實如法而一，得五十六度零一分九十二秒，爲黃赤道小股。

translations.literal: Set the small chord of yellow and red paths; multiply by great base leg fifty-six degrees two minutes sixty-eight; obtain three thousand four hundred ten degrees seventeen minutes twenty zero three zero two four as product; take great chord sixty degrees eighty-seven minutes five as divisor; product according to divisor yields one, obtaining fifty-six degrees one minute ninety-two seconds as small base leg of yellow and red paths.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the small chord by the great base leg 56°0268 to obtain 3410°17203024 as product; divide by the great chord 60°875; the quotient is 56°0192 as the small base leg.

sentences.zh: 又爲赤道小句。

translations.literal: This also serves as the small equatorial altitude.
translations.idiomatic: This value also serves as the small equatorial altitude leg.

sentences.zh: 置矢度八十二秒自之，得六十七微，以全徑一百二十一度七五爲法，除之得五十五纖，爲黃道平半背弦差。

translations.literal: Set sagitta eighty seconds squared, obtaining sixty-seven micro-units; take full diameter one hundred twenty-one degrees seventy-five as divisor; divide to obtain fifty-five fine units as ecliptic level half-back chord difference.
translations.idiomatic: Square the sagitta 82″ to obtain 67 micro-units; divide by the full diameter 121°75 to obtain 55 fine units as the ecliptic half-back chord correction.

sentences.zh: 置黃道半弧弦一度，內減黃道半背弦差，餘爲半弧弦，因因差在微以下不減，即用一度爲半弧弦。

translations.literal: Set ecliptic half-arc chord one degree; within subtract ecliptic half-back chord difference; remainder is half-arc chord; because the difference lies below micro-units it is not subtracted—use one degree directly as half-arc chord.
translations.idiomatic: Set the ecliptic half-arc chord at 1°; subtract the half-back chord correction; because the correction lies below the micro-unit it is not subtracted—take 1° directly as the half-arc chord.

sentences.zh: 置黃道半弧弦一度自之，得一度爲股幕。

translations.literal: Set ecliptic half-arc chord one degree squared, obtaining one degree as leg power.
translations.idiomatic: Square the ecliptic half-arc chord 1° to obtain 1° as the leg power.

sentences.zh: 黃赤道小股五十六度零一矣二自之，得三千一百三十八度一五零七六八六四爲句幕。

translations.literal: Small base leg of yellow and red paths fifty-six degrees one minute ninety-two squared, obtaining three thousand one hundred thirty-eight degrees fifteen minutes seven six eight six four as altitude power.
translations.idiomatic: Square the small base leg 56°0192 to obtain 3138°15076864 as the altitude power.

sentences.zh: 二幕並得三千一百三十九度一五零七六八六四爲弦實，平方開之，得五十六度零二八一，爲赤道小弦。

translations.literal: The two powers combined obtain three thousand one hundred thirty-nine degrees fifteen minutes seven six eight six four as chord product; extract square root, obtaining fifty-six degrees two minutes eighty-one as small equatorial chord.
translations.idiomatic: Add the two powers to obtain 3139°15076864 as the chord product; take the square root to obtain 56°0281 as the small equatorial chord.

sentences.zh: 置黃道半弧弦一度，以半徑即赤道大弦乘之，得六十零度八七五爲實，以赤道小股五十六度零二八一爲法除之，得一度零八分六十五秒，爲赤道半弧弦。

translations.literal: Set ecliptic half-arc chord one degree; multiply by half-radius—that is, great equatorial chord—obtaining sixty degrees eighty-seven minutes five as product; divide by small equatorial chord fifty-six degrees two minutes eighty-one; obtain one degree eight minutes sixty-five seconds as equatorial half-arc chord.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the ecliptic half-arc chord 1° by the half-diameter (the great equatorial chord) to obtain 60°875 as product; divide by the small equatorial chord 56°0281 to obtain 1°0865 as the equatorial half-arc chord.

sentences.zh: 置黃赤道小股五十六度零一九二，又爲赤道小句。

translations.literal: Set small base leg of yellow and red paths fifty-six degrees one minute ninety-two; this also serves as small equatorial altitude.
translations.idiomatic: Set the small base leg at 56°0192; it also serves as the small equatorial altitude leg.

sentences.zh: 以赤道大弦半徑六十零度八七五乘之，得三千四百一十零度一六八八爲實，以赤道小弦爲法除之，得六十零度八十六分五十三秒，爲赤道橫大句。

translations.literal: Multiply by the equatorial great-chord semidiameter of 60 du 87 fen 50 miao, obtaining 3410 du 1688 as dividend; divide by the equatorial small chord as divisor, obtaining 60 du 86 fen 53 miao as the equatorial transverse great leg.
translations.idiomatic: Multiplying by the equatorial great-chord semidiameter of 60°87′50″ yields 3410.1688 as the dividend; dividing by the equatorial small chord gives 60°86′53″ as the equatorial transverse great leg.

sentences.zh: 置半徑六十零度八十七分五十秒，內減赤道大句六十零度八十六分五十三秒，餘九十七秒，爲赤道橫弧矢。

translations.literal: Set the semidiameter at 60 du 87 fen 50 miao; subtract within it the equatorial great leg of 60 du 86 fen 53 miao; the remainder of 97 miao is the equatorial transverse arc-versine.
translations.idiomatic: Take the semidiameter of 60°87′50″ and subtract the equatorial great leg of 60°86′53″; the remainder of 97″ is the equatorial transverse arc-versine.

sentences.zh: 置赤道橫弧矢九十七秒自之，得九十四微零九，以全徑爲法除之，得七十纖，爲赤道背弦差。

translations.literal: Set the equatorial transverse arc-versine of 97 miao and square it, obtaining 94 wei 09; divide by the full diameter as divisor, obtaining 70 xian as the equatorial back-chord difference.
translations.idiomatic: Square the equatorial transverse arc-versine of 97″ to get 94 wei 09; dividing by the full diameter yields 70 xian as the equatorial back-chord correction.

sentences.zh: 置赤道半弧弦一度零八分六十五秒，加赤道背弦差，爲赤道積度，今差在微已下不加，即用半弧弦爲積度。

translations.literal: Set the equatorial half-arc chord of 1 du 08 fen 65 miao and add the equatorial back-chord difference to obtain the equatorial accumulated degree; now the difference lies below the wei and is not added—use the half-arc chord directly as the accumulated degree.
translations.idiomatic: Add the equatorial back-chord correction to the equatorial half-arc chord of 1°08′65″ to obtain the equatorial accumulated degree; since the correction falls below the wei, it is not added—the half-arc chord itself serves as the accumulated degree.

sentences.zh: 凡求得赤道積度一度零八分六十五秒。

translations.literal: In all, the equatorial accumulated degree obtained is 1 du 08 fen 65 miao.
translations.idiomatic: The equatorial accumulated degree thus obtained is 1°08′65″.

sentences.zh: 餘度各如上法，求到各黃道度下赤道積，兩數相減，即得黃赤道差，乃至後之率。

translations.literal: For the remaining degrees, apply the method above in each case to find, under each ecliptic degree, the equatorial accumulation; subtract the two numbers to obtain the yellow-red difference, down to the later rates.
translations.idiomatic: For each remaining degree, repeat the procedure to find the equatorial accumulation under each ecliptic degree; the difference between the two values is the ecliptic–equator correction, carried through to the later rate tables.

sentences.zh: 其分後，以赤道度求黃道，反此求之，其數並同。

translations.literal: After the fen, to seek the ecliptic from the equator, reverse this method; the numbers are all the same.
translations.idiomatic: For the fractional parts, to derive ecliptic from equatorial degrees, invert the same procedure; the quantities are identical.

sentences.zh: ▲黃赤道相求弧矢諸率立成上

translations.literal: ▲ Yellow-red mutual arc-versine rates: ready-made tables, upper section
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Ecliptic–equator mutual arc-versine rates: ready-made tables (upper section)

sentences.zh: 表格略

translations.literal: Table omitted.
translations.idiomatic: [Table omitted.]

sentences.zh: ▲黃赤道相求弧矢諸率立成下

translations.literal: ▲ Yellow-red mutual arc-versine rates: ready-made tables, lower section
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Ecliptic–equator mutual arc-versine rates: ready-made tables (lower section)

sentences.zh: 表格略

translations.literal: Table omitted.
translations.idiomatic: [Table omitted.]

sentences.zh: 按郭敬創法五端，內一曰黃道差，此其根率也。

translations.literal: Commentary: Guo Shoujing established five methods, of which one is ecliptic difference—this is its root rate.
translations.idiomatic: Commentary: Guo Shoujing established five methods; ecliptic difference is one of them, and these are its fundamental rates.

sentences.zh: 舊法以一百一度相減乘。

translations.literal: The old method used subtraction and multiplication by 101 du.
translations.idiomatic: The older method relied on subtracting and multiplying by 101 degrees.

sentences.zh: 《授時》立術，以句股、弧矢、方圓、斜直所容，求其數差，合於渾象之理，視古爲密。

translations.literal: The Season Granting system established its procedure using what is contained by legs-and-hypotenuse, arc-versine, square-and-circle, and oblique-and-straight relations to seek the numerical differences, matching the logic of the armillary sphere and tighter than antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: The Season Granting calendar established its procedure through right-triangle, arc-versine, circle–square, and oblique–rectilinear relations to derive the numerical differences—conforming to the armillary model and finer than antiquity.

sentences.zh: 顧《至元曆經》所載略，又誤以黃道矢度爲積差，黃道矢差爲率，今正之。

translations.literal: Yet what the Zhiyuan Calendar Classic records is abbreviated, and it also wrongly took ecliptic versine degrees as accumulated difference and ecliptic versine difference as rate—here corrected.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the Calendar Classic of the Zhiyuan reign records only an abridgment and also mistakenly treated ecliptic versine degrees as accumulated difference and ecliptic versine difference as rate—here corrected.

sentences.zh: ▲割圓弧矢圖

translations.literal: ▲ Diagram of circle-cutting arc-versine
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Diagram: circle-cutting and arc-versine

sentences.zh: 凡渾圓中剖，則成平圓。

translations.literal: Whenever a sphere is cut through its center, a flat circle results.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever a sphere is bisected through its center, a plane circle results.

sentences.zh: 任割平圓之一分，成弧矢形，皆有弧背，有弧弦，有矢。

translations.literal: Cut any portion of the flat circle and an arc-versine figure is formed, each having arc-back, arc-chord, and versine.
translations.idiomatic: Cut any segment of the plane circle and an arc-versine figure is formed, each with arc-back, arc-chord, and versine.

sentences.zh: 剖弧矢形而半之，則有半弧背，有半弧弦，有矢。

translations.literal: Bisect the arc-versine figure and there are half arc-back, half arc-chord, and versine.
translations.idiomatic: Bisect the arc-versine figure and one has half arc-back, half arc-chord, and versine.

sentences.zh: 因弦矢句股形，以半弧弦爲句，矢減半徑之餘爲股，半徑爲弦。

translations.literal: From the chord-versine right triangle, with the half arc-chord as leg, the remainder after subtracting the versine from the semidiameter as base, and the semidiameter as hypotenuse.
translations.idiomatic: From the chord–versine right triangle: the half arc-chord is the leg, the semidiameter minus the versine is the base, and the semidiameter is the hypotenuse.

sentences.zh: 句股內成小句股，則有小句、小股、小弦、而大小可互求，平側可互用，渾圓之理，斯爲密近。

translations.literal: Within the legs a smaller right triangle is formed, with small leg, small base, and small hypotenuse, so that large and small may be sought from each other, plane and side may be used interchangeably—the logic of the sphere is thereby made close and exact.
translations.idiomatic: Within the legs a smaller right triangle arises, with small leg, small base, and small hypotenuse, so large and small quantities and plane and lateral relations can be interconverted—the spherical principle is thereby rendered precise.

sentences.zh: 平者爲赤道，斜者爲黃道。

translations.literal: The plane is the equator; the oblique is the ecliptic.
translations.idiomatic: The plane circle is the equator; the oblique circle is the ecliptic.

sentences.zh: 因二至黃道赤之距，生大句股。

translations.literal: From the distance between ecliptic and equator at the two solstices, the great right triangle is produced.
translations.idiomatic: From the ecliptic–equator separation at the two solstices arises the great right triangle.

sentences.zh: 因各度黃赤之距，生小句股。

translations.literal: From the yellow-red separation at each degree, the small right triangle is produced.
translations.idiomatic: From the ecliptic–equator separation at each degree arises the small right triangle.

sentences.zh: 外大圓爲赤道。

translations.literal: The outer great circle is the equator.
translations.idiomatic: The outer great circle is the equator.

sentences.zh: 從北極平視，則黃道在赤道內，有赤道各度，即各有其半弧弦，以生大名股。

translations.literal: Viewing from the north pole on the plane, the ecliptic lies within the equator; for each equatorial degree there is its half arc-chord, producing the great-name base.
translations.idiomatic: Viewed from the north pole in the plane, the ecliptic lies inside the equator; each equatorial degree has its half arc-chord, yielding the great base.

sentences.zh: 又各有其相當之黃道半弧弦，以生小句股。

translations.literal: Each also has its corresponding ecliptic half arc-chord, producing the small right triangle.
translations.idiomatic: Each also has its corresponding ecliptic half arc-chord, yielding the small right triangle.

sentences.zh: 此二者皆可互求。

translations.literal: These two may be sought from each other.
translations.idiomatic: The two can be derived from each other.

sentences.zh: 按舊史無圖，然表亦圖之屬也。

translations.literal: Commentary: The old histories had no diagrams, yet tables also belong to the class of diagrams.
translations.idiomatic: Commentary: Earlier histories carried no diagrams, yet ready-made tables are themselves a kind of diagram.

sentences.zh: 今句股割弧矢之法，實爲歷家測算之本。

translations.literal: Now the method of legs-and-hypotenuse for cutting arcs and versines is in fact the foundation of calendrical computation.
translations.idiomatic: The leg–hypotenuse method for cutting arcs and versines is in fact the foundation of calendrical computation.

sentences.zh: 非圖不明，因存其要者數端。

translations.literal: Without a diagram it cannot be made clear; therefore a few essentials are preserved.
translations.idiomatic: Without a diagram it cannot be made clear; therefore a few essentials are preserved here.

sentences.zh: ▲黃赤道內外度

translations.literal: ▲ Ecliptic and equator: inner and outer degrees
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Ecliptic and equator: degrees within and without

sentences.zh: 推黃道各度，距赤道內外及去極遠近術。

translations.literal: Procedure for deriving, at each ecliptic degree, the distance within or without the equator and the distance from the pole.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for deriving, at each ecliptic degree, the distance within or without the equator and the distance from the pole.

sentences.zh: 置半徑內減去赤道小弦，餘爲赤道二絃差。

translations.literal: Set the semidiameter and subtract within it the equatorial small chord; the remainder is the equatorial double-chord difference.
translations.idiomatic: Take the semidiameter and subtract the equatorial small chord; the remainder is the equatorial double-chord difference.

sentences.zh: 又爲黃赤道小弧矢，又爲內外矢，又爲股弦差。

translations.literal: This also serves as the yellow-red small arc-versine, also as inner-and-outer versine, and also as base–hypotenuse difference.
translations.idiomatic: This value also serves as the ecliptic–equator small arc-versine, as the inner-and-outer versine, and as the base–hypotenuse difference.

sentences.zh: 置半徑內外減去黃道矢度，餘爲黃赤道小弦，以二至黃赤道內外半弧弦乘之爲實，以黃赤道大弦爲法，即半徑。

translations.literal: Set the semidiameter and subtract within or without the ecliptic versine degree; the remainder is the yellow-red small chord; multiply it by the solstitial yellow-red inner-and-outer half arc-chord as dividend, with the yellow-red great chord as divisor—that is, the semidiameter.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the ecliptic versine degree from the semidiameter (within or without as the case requires); the remainder is the ecliptic–equator small chord. Multiply it by the solstitial inner-and-outer half arc-chord as dividend and divide by the ecliptic–equator great chord (the semidiameter).

sentences.zh: 除之爲黃赤道小弧弦。

translations.literal: Divide to obtain the yellow-red small arc-chord.
translations.idiomatic: The quotient is the ecliptic–equator small arc-chord.

sentences.zh: 即黃赤道內外半弧弦，又爲黃赤道小句。

translations.literal: That is, the yellow-red inner-and-outer half arc-chord, and also the yellow-red small leg.
translations.idiomatic: This is the ecliptic–equator inner-and-outer half arc-chord, and also the ecliptic–equator small leg.

sentences.zh: 置黃赤道小弧矢自之，即赤道二絃差。

translations.literal: Set the yellow-red small arc-versine and square it—that is, the equatorial double-chord difference.
translations.idiomatic: Square the ecliptic–equator small arc-versine to obtain the equatorial double-chord difference.

sentences.zh: 以全徑除之，爲半背弦差。

translations.literal: Divide by the full diameter to obtain the half back-chord difference.
translations.idiomatic: Divide by the full diameter to obtain the half back-chord correction.

sentences.zh: 以差加黃赤道小弧弦爲黃赤道小弧半背，即黃赤道內外度。

translations.literal: Add the difference to the yellow-red small arc-chord to obtain the yellow-red small half arc-back—that is, the yellow-red inner-and-outer degree.
translations.idiomatic: Add the correction to the ecliptic–equator small arc-chord to obtain the small half arc-back—that is, the ecliptic–equator inner-and-outer degree.

sentences.zh: 置黃赤道內外度，視在盈初縮末限以加，在縮初盈天限以減，皆加減象限度，即各得太陽去北極度分。

translations.literal: Set the yellow-red inner-and-outer degree; where it falls within the limit of waxing-at-beginning and waning-at-end, add; where within the limit of waning-at-beginning and waxing-at-end, subtract; in each case add or subtract the quadrant limit, and one obtains each solar distance from the north pole in degrees and minutes.
translations.idiomatic: Take the ecliptic–equator inner-and-outer degree: add the quadrant limit where it falls within the waxing-initial and waning-final limit, subtract where within the waning-initial and waxing-final limit—in each case yielding the Sun's distance from the north pole in degrees and minutes.

sentences.zh: 如冬至後四十四度，求太陽去赤道內外及去極度。

translations.literal: For example, after the winter solstice at 44 degrees, seek the Sun's distance within or without the equator and from the pole.
translations.idiomatic: Example: after the winter solstice at 44°, find the Sun's distance within or without the equator and from the pole.

sentences.zh: 術曰：「置半徑六十零度八十七分半，內減黃道四十四度下赤道小弦五十八度三十五分六十九秒，餘二度五十一分八十一秒，爲黃赤道小弧矢。

translations.literal: The procedure says: "Set the semidiameter at 60 du 87 fen 30 miao; subtract within it the equatorial small chord at 44 degrees ecliptic of 58 du 35 fen 69 miao; the remainder of 2 du 51 fen 81 miao is the yellow-red small arc-versine.
translations.idiomatic: The procedure says: "Set the semidiameter at 60°87′30″. Subtract the equatorial small chord at ecliptic 44° (58°35′69″); the remainder of 2°51′81″ is the ecliptic–equator small arc-versine.

sentences.zh: 即內外矢。

translations.literal: That is, the inner-and-outer versine.
translations.idiomatic: That is, the inner-and-outer versine.

sentences.zh: 置半徑六十零度八七五，內減黃道四十四度，矢一十六度五十六分八十二秒，餘四十四三十零分六十八秒，爲黃赤道小弦。

translations.literal: Set the semidiameter at 60 du 87 fen 50 miao; subtract within it the ecliptic versine at 44 degrees of 16 du 56 fen 82 miao; the remainder of 44 du 30 fen 68 miao is the yellow-red small chord.
translations.idiomatic: Set the semidiameter at 60°87′50″. Subtract the ecliptic versine at 44° (16°56′82″); the remainder of 44°30′68″ is the ecliptic–equator small chord.

sentences.zh: 置黃赤道小弦，以二至黃赤道內外半弧弦二十三度七十一分乘之，得一千零五十零度五十一分四二三八爲實，以黃赤道大弦六十零度八七五爲法除之，得一十七度二十五分十九秒爲黃赤道小弧弦。

translations.literal: Set the yellow-red small chord and multiply by the solstitial yellow-red inner-and-outer half arc-chord of 23 du 71 fen, obtaining 1050 du 51 fen 4238 as dividend; divide by the yellow-red great chord of 60 du 87 fen 50 miao as divisor, obtaining 17 du 25 fen 19 miao as the yellow-red small arc-chord.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the ecliptic–equator small chord by the solstitial inner-and-outer half arc-chord of 23°71′ to obtain 1050°51′4238 as dividend; dividing by the ecliptic–equator great chord of 60°87′50″ yields 17°25′19″ as the ecliptic–equator small arc-chord.

sentences.zh: 即內外半弧弦。

translations.literal: That is, the inner-and-outer half arc-chord.
translations.idiomatic: That is, the inner-and-outer half arc-chord.

sentences.zh: 置黃赤道小弧矢二度五十一分八十一秒自之爲實，以全徑地百二十一度七十五分除之，得五分二十一秒爲背弦差，以差加黃赤道小弧弦一十七度二十五分六十九秒，得一十七度三十零分八十九秒，爲二至前後四十四度，太陽去赤道內外度。

translations.literal: Set the yellow-red small arc-versine of 2 du 51 fen 81 miao and square it as dividend; divide by the full diameter of 121 du 75 fen, obtaining 5 fen 21 miao as back-chord difference; add the difference to the yellow-red small arc-chord of 17 du 25 fen 69 miao, obtaining 17 du 30 fen 89 miao as, for 44 degrees before and after the solstice, the Sun's distance within or without the equator.
translations.idiomatic: Square the ecliptic–equator small arc-versine of 2°51′81″ and divide by the full diameter of 121°75′ to obtain a back-chord correction of 5′21″; adding this to the small arc-chord of 17°25′69″ gives 17°30′89″ as the Sun's equatorial inner-and-outer distance at 44° from the solstice.

sentences.zh: 置象限九十一度三十一分四十三秒七五，以內外度一十七度三零八九加之，得一百零八度六十二分三十二秒七五，爲冬至後四十四度太陽去北極度。

translations.literal: Set the quadrant limit of 91 du 31 fen 43 miao 75 wei and add the inner-and-outer degree of 17 du 30 fen 89 miao, obtaining 108 du 62 fen 32 miao 75 wei as the Sun's distance from the north pole at 44 degrees after the winter solstice.
translations.idiomatic: Take the quadrant limit of 91°31′43″75 wei and add the inner-and-outer degree of 17°30′89″, obtaining 108°62′32″75 wei as the Sun's distance from the north pole at 44° after the winter solstice.

sentences.zh: ▲黃道每度去赤道內外及去北極立成

translations.literal: ▲ Ready-made tables: each ecliptic degree's distance within or without the equator and from the pole
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Ready-made tables: for each ecliptic degree, distance within or without the equator and from the pole

sentences.zh: 表格略

translations.literal: Table omitted.
translations.idiomatic: [Table omitted.]

sentences.zh: ▲白道交周

translations.literal: ▲ White path: nodal cycle
translations.idiomatic: ▲ White path: nodal period

sentences.zh: 推白赤道正交，距黃赤道正交北極數。

translations.literal: Derive the white-red equatorial node and the number from the yellow-red equatorial node to the north pole.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for deriving the white-path equatorial node and its polar distance from the ecliptic–equator node.

sentences.zh: 術曰：「置實測白道出入黃道內外六度爲半徑弧弦，又爲大圖弧矢，又爲股弦差。

translations.literal: The procedure says: "Set the empirically measured white path's entry and exit within and without the ecliptic at 6 degrees as semidiameter arc-chord, also as great-circle arc-versine, and also as base–hypotenuse difference.
translations.idiomatic: The procedure says: "Take the empirically measured white path's separation from the ecliptic at 6° as semidiameter arc-chord, also as great-circle arc-versine, and also as base–hypotenuse difference.

sentences.zh: 置半徑六十零度七五自之，得三千七百零五度七六五六二五，以矢六度而一，得六百一十七度六十三分爲股弦和，加矢六度，共六百二十三度六十三分爲大圓徑。

translations.literal: Set the semidiameter at 60 du 75 miao and square it, obtaining 3705 du 765625; divide by the versine of 6 degrees, obtaining 617 du 63 fen as base–hypotenuse sum; add the versine of 6 degrees, totaling 623 du 63 fen as the great-circle diameter.
translations.idiomatic: Square the semidiameter of 60°75″ to obtain 3705°765625; dividing by the 6° versine yields 617°63′ as the base–hypotenuse sum; adding the 6° versine gives 623°63′ as the great-circle diameter.

sentences.zh: 依法求得容闊五度七十分，又爲小句。

translations.literal: By the prescribed method the contained breadth of 5 du 70 fen is obtained, and this also serves as the small leg.
translations.idiomatic: By the prescribed method the contained breadth of 5°70′ is obtained, which also serves as the small leg.

sentences.zh: 又以二至出入半弧弦二十三度七十一分爲大句。

translations.literal: Again take the solstitial entry-and-exit half arc-chord of 23 du 71 fen as the great leg.
translations.idiomatic: Take the solstitial entry-and-exit half arc-chord of 23°71′ as the great leg.

sentences.zh: 以大句爲法，除大股五十六度零六分五十秒，得二度三十七分就整爲度差。

translations.literal: With the great leg as divisor, divide the great base of 56 du 06 fen 50 miao, obtaining 2 du 37 fen rounded to the whole as the degree difference.
translations.idiomatic: Divide the great base of 56°06′50″ by the great leg as divisor, obtaining 2°37′ rounded to the nearest degree as the degree difference.

sentences.zh: 以度差乘小句，得小股一十三度四十七分八十二秒，爲容半長。

translations.literal: Multiply the degree difference by the small leg, obtaining the small base of 13 du 47 fen 82 miao as the contained half-length.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the degree difference by the small leg to obtain the small base of 13°47′82″ as the contained half-length.

sentences.zh: 置半徑六十零度八七五爲大弦，以乘小句五度七十分爲實，以大句二十三度七十一分爲法除之，得一十四度六十三分爲小弦，又爲白赤道正交，距黃赤道正交半弧弦。

translations.literal: Set the semidiameter of 60 du 87 fen 50 miao as great hypotenuse and multiply by the small leg of 5 du 70 fen as dividend; divide by the great leg of 23 du 71 fen as divisor, obtaining 14 du 63 fen as small chord, and also as the white-red equatorial node's half arc-chord distance from the yellow-red equatorial node.
translations.idiomatic: Take the semidiameter of 60°87′50″ as great hypotenuse and multiply by the small leg of 5°70′; dividing by the great leg of 23°71′ yields 14°63′ as small chord, and also as the half arc-chord between the white-path equatorial node and the ecliptic–equator node.

sentences.zh: 依法求行半弧背一十四度六十六分，爲白赤道正交距黃赤道正交極婁數。

translations.literal: By the prescribed method seek the half arc-back of 14 du 66 fen, which is the polar number for the white-red equatorial node's distance from the yellow-red equatorial node.
translations.idiomatic: By the prescribed method the half arc-back of 14°66′ is obtained as the polar distance of the white-path equatorial node from the ecliptic–equator node.
